api_wallet_help:
Connect an API wallet in Telegram

1. Open https://app.hyperliquid.xyz/API for mainnet or https://app.hyperliquid-testnet.xyz/API for testnet.
2. Click Connect and connect the MAIN wallet whose account holds your funds.
3. Name a dedicated API wallet, e.g. HIP4Bot, and click Generate. Save its API private key in a password manager. This is NOT your main private key or seed phrase.
4. Authorize that API wallet and confirm in the main wallet. Check its address and Valid Until in the authorized list. Generate alone does not authorize it.
5. Return to this private chat: Wallet / Settings → Connect API wallet. Check the network.
6. First button, Wallet: send your MAIN account public address, not the API-agent address.
7. Second button, Private key: review the displayed account/network, then send only the dedicated API private key. Entering it saves the connection and replaces the previous one, if any. The bot immediately deletes the message, checks authorization, and saves the key encrypted in a protected file. If deletion fails, nothing is saved; delete the message manually.
8. After the success message, use the bot. No restart, browser console, JSON, SSH tunnel or daily reconnect is needed.

API key only, in your own bot's private chat only. Message deletion does not guarantee removal from notifications or Telegram infrastructure. Never send a main key/seed.

Funds stay in the main account; do not fund the API wallet. Agents can lose funds through trading but cannot withdraw. Permission lasts until expiry/revocation. Revoke on the API page; stopping the bot does not revoke it. To replace/renew, create a new API wallet and repeat the two buttons.

The API wallet cannot approve it; the bot never signs this approval.
